scope: Research papers on compressing a pretrained large language model's (or large transformer's) weights by means other than quantization, 2019-2026, that neither the Awesome-LLM-Compression catalogue nor references/papers.json holds (matched by arXiv id and by title). Papers whose primary contribution is quantization, KV-cache compression or prompt compression are left out.
method: Each category's queries ran against the arXiv API (export.arxiv.org/api/query, sortBy=relevance, submittedDate 2019-01-01 to 2026-12-31, at least 3 s apart); the pooled results were screened by title and abstract, preferring well-cited and representative work, one version per paper. A paper is kept only when its PDF downloads and its text extract is non-trivial.
